jobs.details: O poslodavcu Do you enjoy finding out why a conversion stopped firing, and then fixing it properly? Want to turn tracking data into decisions clients can trust? At s360, you will help Danish clients build measurement setups that make their marketing more reliable and useful. You will be working closely with the Measurement team across Europe to make sure the data our clients use to run their marketing is correct. Measurement Specialist is a dedicated measurement and tracking specialist role, not a software development position. Your focus is 100% on tags, analytics pipelines, and data reliability. Deliver tracking that holds up You will work across quick fixes and larger implementations, making sure setups are technically sound, well documented, and ready for client use. On smaller tasks, you will own the process from start to finish, including client contact. On larger builds, a Denmark-based lead will handle scoping and the client relationship while you own the delivery. Your main responsibilities will be: Troubleshooting: Find and fix tracking issues across Google Ads, GA4, Meta and other ad platforms for Danish clients. Implementation projects: Build and configure GA4 and Google Tag Manager setups, client-side and server-side, including Consent Mode v2, Enhanced Conversions and conversion APIs. dataLayer specifications: Write dataLayer specifications for client developers and validate their implementation before go-live. Ownership: Own small tasks end to end, including direct client contact, and deliver the build on larger projects scoped by a Denmark-based lead. Quality assurance: Test every setup before handover so it passes Quality Assurance checks without rework. Documentation: Document each implementation so a colleague can take it over without a handover meeting.
